Worker inventories include dirty and unique-commit paths; duplicate paths may be different source versions.
The two new reconciliation artifacts are excluded to avoid recursive self-hashes. Handoff/status hashes include the new cross-links.
Per-file areas are inventory categories, not independently buildable PR boundaries. All source remains pending selective current-main review.
Text probes use cached main and current file bytes, not the one newer remote backend commit. Gitlinks are recorded separately.
